title: sorbus aucuparia lanuginosa
intro: Sorbus aucuparia lanuginosa, commonly known as the Woolly Rowan, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, gastrointestinal issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of the Woolly Rowan are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. Furthermore, the plant's extracts have been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, diarrhea, and skin conditions.
